How data looks like and what are we trying to model?##

We are working with dataset of F1s natural accessions crossed to Col-0 ddm1 mutant (maternal haplotype in all crosses). After quantification by RSEM using Col0 as a reference genome, we have a matrix of transposable elements and genes either expressed, not present or silenced among all samples.

Our experiment has been done in the way that every sequencing plate has been carrying controls on the Col0 haplotype: 1) maternal *ddm1* haplotype (Col0) where we expect activation of TEs, 2) maternal haplotype (Col0) WT ddm1, where we see almost no expression of TEs due to the natural silencing.

In order to distinguish not present from silenced (or re-silenced) we can calculate number of TEs and/or genes in the following categories. For that, we always have a maternal *ddm1* haplotype (Col0) to compare to. In this haplotype all TEs should be expressed on the maximum level, because no re-silencing happens (no cross). As well as we have pure Col0 WT (active ddm1). Then we can categorize TEs based on the expression level:

1.  Off in Col0 WT and off in Col0 *ddm1* (more likely dead TE)
2.  Off in Col0 WT and on in Col0 *ddm1* (TE affected by ddm1 mutation)
3.  On in Col0 WT and on in Col0 *ddm1* (epi-allele?)
4.  On in Col0 WT and off in Col0 *ddm1* (wierd TEs probably representing a dosage effect)

### How many TEs are expressed in *ddm1* control in comparison to WT (Col0 haplotype)?

```{r}
library(arrow)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
# Counts anti-sense
rsem_counts_sense <- read_csv_arrow(
  "/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/04_output/limma_output/sense_expr_te_genes_no_filter_reads_log2cpm_normalization.csv.gz",
  col_names = TRUE
)
# Counts sense
```

```{r}
library(data.table)
# Get TEs detected in each control group
setDT(rsem_counts_sense)
# Get only controls 
controls <- rsem_counts_sense[genotype %in% c("ddm1_ct", "ct_col")]
```

```{r}
# Categorize per TE per sample (not averaged)
controls[, feature_type := fifelse(grepl("TE", id), "TE", "gene")]
te_controls <- controls[feature_type == "gene"]

# Define on/off per TE per sample
te_per_sample <- te_controls[, .(id, sample_id, genotype, plate, log2cpm, replicate,Sequencing_date, Set)]
te_per_sample[, is_on := log2cpm >= 1]

# Find plates that have both genotypes
valid_plates <- te_per_sample[, .(has_both = all(c("ct_col", "ddm1_ct") %in% genotype)), by = plate][has_both == TRUE, plate]
# Filter
te_per_sample <- te_per_sample[plate %in% valid_plates]

```

We see that TEs are highly 0 inflated. Let's caclculate attribution for each of the categories

```{r}
# Assign TE status 
te_status <- te_per_sample[, .(
  on_in_ct_col  = all(is_on[genotype == "ct_col"]),
  on_in_ddm1_ct = all(is_on[genotype == "ddm1_ct"])
), by = .(id, plate)]

# Categorize per TE per plate
te_status[, category := fcase(
  on_in_ct_col == FALSE & on_in_ddm1_ct == FALSE, "off_wt/off_ddm1",
  on_in_ct_col == FALSE & on_in_ddm1_ct == TRUE,  "off_wt/on_ddm1",
  on_in_ct_col == TRUE  & on_in_ddm1_ct == TRUE,  "on_wt/on_ddm1",
  on_in_ct_col == TRUE  & on_in_ddm1_ct == FALSE, "on_wt/off_ddm1"
)]

# Counts per category per plate
te_status[, .N, by = .(plate, category)][order(plate, category)]
# Calculate for every plate and visualie
cat_counts <- te_status[, .N, by = .(plate, category)][order(plate, category)]
# Make a plot 
cat_counts %>% filter(category!="off_wt/off_ddm1") %>% ggplot(aes(x = N, y = factor(plate), fill = category)) +
  geom_col(position = "stack") +
  #geom_text(aes(label = N), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 2) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  labs(title = "TE categories per plate (Col0 haplotype)",
       x = "Number of TEs", y = "Plate", fill = "")
```

What is the expression distribution in these categories (except of off/off?)

```{r}
te_per_sample_cat <- merge(te_per_sample, te_status[, .(id, plate, category)], by = c("id", "plate"))

te_per_sample_cat %>% 
  #filter(genotype=="ddm1_ct") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = log2cpm, fill = genotype)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, alpha = 0.7, position = "identity") +
  facet_wrap(~category, scales = "free") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  labs(title = "gene expression distribution,on >=1 count",
       x = "log2CPM", y = "Count", fill = "")

```

Next question we wanna answer is how consistent this response in each of the categories? How many replicates among plates share the same TEs with the same effect?

```{r}
colors <-c("#A64D79","#452829","#408A71","#1D546D")
library(UpSetR)

# For each TE, which plates have it as "ddm1-responsive"?
te_responsive <- te_status[category == "off_wt/on_ddm1"]
upset_mat <- dcast(te_responsive, id ~ paste0("", plate), 
                   value.var = "category", fun.aggregate = length)
upset_df <- as.data.frame(upset_mat)
rownames(upset_df) <- upset_df$id
upset_df$id <- NULL

upset(upset_df, 
      sets = colnames(upset_df),
      order.by = "freq",
      nintersects = 10,
      main.bar.color = "#408A71",
      text.scale = 1.3,
      mainbar.y.label = "Number of shared genes",
      sets.x.label = "genes per plate")
```

Take TEs which are off in wt and on in ddm1 and check heatmap on the whole dataset

```{r}
tes_of_interest <- te_status[category == "off_wt/on_ddm1",]

rsem_counts_sense_filtered <- rsem_counts_sense[id %in% tes_of_interest$id,]

## genes/TEs present in all plates
n_plates <- length(unique(te_responsive$plate))
consistent_tes <- rownames(upset_df)[rowSums(upset_df) == n_plates]
consistent_tes

```

Model of overall expression.

Test importance of the genotype

```{r}
# Select ddm1 because other values are close to 0 in control crosses 
rsem_counts_sense_filtered_ddm1 <- rsem_counts_sense_filtered[rsem_counts_sense_filtered$genotype=="ddm1",]

library(lmerTest)

mbase <- lmer(
  log2cpm ~ (1 | accession) + (1 | plate),
  data = rsem_counts_sense_filtered_ddm1 # gausian model because values are already log2 
)

summary(mbase)

vc <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(mbase))
vc$proportion <- vc$vcov / sum(vc$vcov)

ggplot(vc, aes(x = grp, y = proportion, fill = grp)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(proportion, 4)), vjust = -0.5) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
  labs(title = "Variance explained by random effects",
       x = "", y = "Proportion of variance", fill = "")
```

Test importance of the individual TE

```{r}
mbase <- lmer(
  log2cpm ~ (1 | accession) + (1 | plate) +(1|id),
  data = rsem_counts_sense_filtered_ddm1 # gausian model because values are already log2 transformed 
)

summary(mbase)

vc <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(mbase))
vc$proportion <- vc$vcov / sum(vc$vcov)

ggplot(vc, aes(x = grp, y = proportion, fill = grp)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(proportion, 4)), vjust = -0.5) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
  labs(title = "Variance explained by random effects",
       x = "", y = "Proportion of variance", fill = "")
```

Test importance of the TE family

```{r}
te_annotation <- fread("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/11_resources/ref_genome/TAIR10_Transposable_Elements.txt")
```

```{r}
# Join with TE annotation
te_annotation_with_superfamily <- left_join(rsem_counts_sense_filtered_ddm1, te_annotation, by = c("id" = "Transposon_Name"))

mbase <- lmer(
  log2cpm ~ (1 | accession) + (1 | plate) +(1|id)+(1|Transposon_Family),
  data = te_annotation_with_superfamily # gausian model because values are already log2 transformed 
)

summary(mbase)

vc <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(mbase))
vc$proportion <- vc$vcov / sum(vc$vcov)

ggplot(vc, aes(x = grp, y = proportion, fill = grp)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(proportion, 4)), vjust = -0.5) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
  labs(title = "Variance explained by random effects",
       x = "", y = "Proportion of variance", fill = "")
```

Test importance of the TE Superfamily

```{r}
# Join with TE annotation
te_annotation_with_superfamily <- left_join(rsem_counts_sense_filtered_ddm1, te_annotation, by = c("id" = "Transposon_Name"))

mbase <- lmer(
  log2cpm ~ (1 | accession) + (1 | plate) +(1|id)+(1|Transposon_Family) + (1|Transposon_Super_Family),
  data = te_annotation_with_superfamily # gausian model because values are already log2 transformed 
)

summary(mbase)

vc <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(mbase))
vc$proportion <- vc$vcov / sum(vc$vcov)

ggplot(vc, aes(x = grp, y = proportion, fill = grp)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(proportion, 4)), vjust = -0.5) +
```
